=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/implement_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:455-467 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: When the repair editor exits nonzero, `implement_prepush_test_gate_repair` returns early with `gate_repair="skipped (editor exit ${rc})"`, so the syntax re-validation (`validate_changed_files_syntax.sh`, line 468), the `all` revert and the second gate run all get skipped, and only edits outside the allow-list are rolled back (line 458).
  WHY: `codex_isolated_exec.sh` writes workspace edits back even after a failed or interrupted attempt (761-776). A partial or syntax-broken edit inside the allow-list can therefore reach "Commit changes" without any check, because "Enforce syntax validation outcome" already ran and `continue-on-error: true` hides the failure. The existing post-Codex syntax repair (implement.yml 5114-5119) fails the run instead. All reviewers rate this MAJOR.
- scripts/implement_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:306-314, 421-422, 469 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `gate_baseline="$(git stash create ... 2>/dev/null || true)"` silently falls back to `HEAD` when the stash is empty or fails, so `implement_prepush_test_gate_revert all` (`git restore --source="${gate_baseline}"`) restores every tracked file that differs from HEAD, not just the repair's edits.
  WHY: When post-repair syntax validation fails, this wipes the main editor's whole implementation, and "Commit changes" then commits an implementation-free tree that is reported as a no-op. Possible causes: an unmerged index, a missing committer identity (scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh:311-312 sets the author later), or an unusable GIT_INDEX_FILE. Severity disagreement: gemini says BLOCKER, the others say MAJOR, so the highest is used. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 explicitly judged the HEAD fallback safe, on the grounds that an empty stash means there are no tracked changes.
- scripts/implement_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:405-415 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The repair allow-list (changed files ∪ affected_tests ∪ companion_files ∪ failures[].file) is never intersected with the issue's `files_touched` scope or the automation-path grant, yet the repair prompt tells the editor to "Add missing registry entries (INVENTORY rows, `ci.yml` wiring)".
  WHY: A compliant repair edits a path outside the scope, such as docs/INVENTORY.md, .github/workflows/ci.yml or an unlisted affected test. The commit-time `files_touched_scope_guard.py` (implement.yml ~4589-4653 / scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh 556-599) then refuses the commit and latches `ai:scope-blocked`, which breaks the "push is never blocked" (Q3) contract. minimax adds that `companion_files` is empty in practice, because `_resolve_statuses` maps existing paths to "M", not "A". Registry edits are then rolled back as strays, so missing-registry failures can never be repaired.
- scripts/implement_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:264-268 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The wrapper gets `--venv` but no `--deps-root` for the prep roots that `prepare --deps` records in `${root}/work` (work/node_modules).
  WHY: The snapshot excludes node_modules, so Node tests fail on both trees, get classified `inherited`, and the gate reports `pass` for broken tests.
- scripts/implement_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:281-304 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The revert's stray set comes from `git diff --name-only -z HEAD` and includes in-tree staged support copies that the allow-list deliberately excludes.
  WHY: The revert reaches further than the allow-list. Staged support installs are rewritten to HEAD, which can corrupt the execution environment for later runs.
- scripts/implement_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:421-422, 313, 458, 469 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The `git stash create` failure is silently ignored, and a full-tree revert happens without any log line saying that the fallback was used.
  WHY: Operators see `outcome=repair_reverted reason=syntax` and an empty PR, with nothing pointing to the baseline fallback.
- scripts/codex_isolated_exec.sh:108-109, 170-173, 347-350 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The shared codex sandbox Dockerfile now pins `ruff==0.17.2`.
  WHY: If `pip install` fails (registry issue, yanked package), the image build fails, `prepare` exits nonzero, and the whole implement phase fails.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:5362-5372 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The "Pre-push affected-test gate" step has a fixed `timeout-minutes: 60`, but `implement_prepush_test_gate_mode` (scripts/implement_step_prepush_test_gate.sh 184-185) accepts `PREPUSH_TEST_GATE_TIMEOUT_MINUTES` up to 360. Each run's wall budget is `timeout*60+120` (prepush_test_gate_run.sh:192), and there can be two runs plus an editor turn plus an image build.
  WHY: The default of 15 is already close to 60 minutes, and about 20 or more is guaranteed to overrun. A step kill skips the stray rollback (458), the symlink restore (461) and the syntax re-validation (468), and `continue-on-error: true` lets partial edits through to "Commit changes". Severity disagreement: minimax says MAJOR, the others say NIT, so the highest is used.
- scripts/implement_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:534 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `if [ "${gate_repair}" = ran ] || [ "${gate_repair}" = "reverted (syntax)" ]` starts a second full container pass even after `revert all` has restored the exact tree that run 1 already tested.
  WHY: This adds a redundant ~17-minute pass (`timeout*60+120`) to the 60-minute step budget, which raises the risk that the step is killed before the summary or PR-body section is written.
- scripts/implement_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:142-157 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The summary passes `changed_assertions[].line` to `write_summary` (workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py:787-789), which puts the assertion source text into the PR-body section.
  WHY: The issue says the summary holds test names and paths only.
- scripts/implement_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:398-404 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: When `CODEX_ISOLATED_IMPLEMENT_ROOT` is absent, the root freshly prepared by `codex_isolated_exec.sh prepare --deps` is held only in a local variable and is never exported or cleaned up.
  WHY: The implement.yml cleanup (~7109) removes only `CODEX_ISOLATED_IMPLEMENT_ROOT`, so a `codex-isolated-*` root with its full venv/node deps leaks under RUNNER_TEMP.
- scripts/implement_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:425-428 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: `implement_prepush_test_gate_changed` and `git ls-files --others --exclude-standard` list `.codex-workflow-src/` and other runtime artifacts as untracked changes, because there is no root .gitignore or info/exclude.
  WHY: The trusted support tree ends up in CHANGED FILES and the EFFECTIVE REPAIR ALLOW-LIST, is never rolled back as a stray, and the tar backup archives the nested checkout including its .git.
- scripts/implement_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:281-297, 306-314 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The allow-list rollback compares blobs with `git hash-object`, which ignores file mode changes.
  WHY: A repair that only changes a tracked file's executable bit escapes the revert.
- scripts/implement_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:119-126, 405-411 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `failures[].file` values from the container-produced `result.json` are added to the allow-list with only "not absolute" and "no `..`" checks. Newline-bearing paths and `.claude/` / `.github/ai/` paths are not excluded.
  WHY: The editor is told it may edit extra paths, and edits there are not rolled back by `revert strays`. Commit-time `files_touched_scope_guard.py` still limits what gets committed.
- scripts/implement_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:366-377 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The "=== CURRENT DIFF FOR ALLOW-LIST FILES ===" prompt block is not `::`-neutralised, unlike the captured-failure block (line 114).
  WHY: This is inconsistent with the documented neutralisation and gives the model a channel to emit text that looks like workflow commands.
- scripts/implement_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:313-314 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `git restore ... || true` and `git rm ... || true` swallow failures, and the caller still logs `outcome=warning reason=stray_edits_rolled_back`.
  WHY: A failed restore leaves the stray edit to be committed while the log claims it was rolled back.
- scripts/implement_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:345-347 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: A tracked symlink is removed (`rm -rf`) before `git checkout HEAD -- "${path}"`, and a checkout failure does not undo the deletion.
  WHY: The next step's `git add -u` stages the deletion of a tracked symlink that the repair was never allowed to touch.
- scripts/implement_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:260-262, 521-525 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `gate_image` comes from the staged `codex_isolated_exec.sh` copy (fetched from `SCRIPT_REF`), which has no `image` action until this change is released. The gate therefore falls back with reason `image_unavailable`.
  WHY: Consumers, and this repo until the next stable release, always report `unverified`/`image_unavailable`, which reads as a broken gate. A distinct reason such as `support_image_action_missing` is needed.
- scripts/codex_isolated_exec.sh:170-173 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The sandbox image pins `ruff==0.17.2`, while CI installs ruff unpinned (.github/workflows/ci.yml:218, ci.yml:660) and runs the same `ruff check --select E,F --ignore E501`.
  WHY: Version drift makes the gate report lint failures that CI does not reproduce, or the reverse. The pin also affects every phase that builds the image.
- agents.md / agents.d/8190-prepush-gate-implement.md:agents.md:3992 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The new `PREPUSH_TEST_GATE phase=implement ...` shape (scripts/implement_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:40) and its outcome vocabulary are documented only in the fragment, not in the "Stable log prefixes (contractual)" registry entry, which lists only `phase=run|config|wrapper`.
  WHY: Workflow-log-analysis parses the contractual registry, so the new shape is invisible to it and is open to undocumented contract drift.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
